status: Public source prerelease and website live; v0.1.12-alpha.1 release candidate verified

components.evidence_level: Public source prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB and Wi-Fi; native Grok Bot calls observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: The v0.1.12-alpha.1 hub release candidate records gateway 0.1.0a11 on PyPI (owner-approved trusted publishing on 13 October 2026; files byte-identical to the GitHub release's SHA256SUMS; pip install --pre checked) with Linux SDK v0.1.0-alpha.6, ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.12 and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. Adds ADR 007, the Remote HTTPS record and the Connect your Grok Bot and Track usage guides. On 13 October 2026 the owner's Grok Bot called the six tools natively from the Mac and the iPhone through an owner-run tunnel with OAuth sign-in; the gateway log recorded nine grok-bot calls and the owner saw the OLED text. One owner setup; independent reproduction is not claimed.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; Wi-Fi device listener used by one physical kit; native Grok Bot calls through serve --oauth observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: 233 tests (Python 3.11 to 3.14), Ruff, plain-language checks, the first-success check and the release workflow's fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed. Adds tunnel hardening (remote requests need a named token or sign-in, remote off kill switch, request log required, device port refuses HTTP), usage records, summary and hook, and owner-approved OAuth sign-in. On 13 October 2026 the owner's Grok Bot called the six tools natively from the Mac and the iPhone through this code (hub docs/verification/grok-remote-https-2026-10-13.md). Linux systemd is not tested on a real host.

55 tests passed, including the gateway integration tests against gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10; Ruff, package builds and twine check passed. The gateway extra pins gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10, so the SDK and its gateway install from PyPI. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; four firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: Host CTest suites (9/9), the contract check, the gateway PTY integration and three firmware builds passed. Alpha.12 resolves a .local gateway name with ESPmDNS and verifies TLS by name; on the owner's kit it connected by name and followed two Mac address changes and a restart. Earlier USB, Wi-Fi, wrong-password and face checks stand. One kit; not independently reproduced.

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.

firmware.status: build verified; hardware and Grok pending; unpublished
